subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------PRO.TF.C.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 104 (T(AF)M-8). LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PRO-TF-C is the partner. From the subject: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and AF-DT (affinity dictates). From PHY-U-P: STY (style), with the (D) prefix, "the dynamics of". From AF-DT: ACC-F (accelerated functionalism). From ACC-F: AGT (agreement), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and TRS (transition). From AGT: EXT-F (extended functionalism).
